rationale: Y independently rediscovers two of the ground truth's most specific findings almost verbatim: the ceil-vs-floor division latent bug at audio_tokenizer_v2.py:949 (linyueqian's exact line and fix) and the docstring-vs-signature default mismatch in configuration_moss_audio_tokenizer_v2.py. X's findings are plausible and well-argued but hit none of the human reviewers' concerns, and X's confident claim that vendored files 'carry a proper... attribution header' directly contradicts a ground-truth complaint. Both are highly actionable with file/line anchors and suggested diffs; Y has one likely false positive (put_req_chunk increment) that X's own investigation contradicts, slightly denting its precision, but its much higher recall on verifiable, high-value bugs decides it.
